label: Bible Study
prompt: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his _____.
verse: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
note: Make your plans, by all means — but the LORD holds the pen for the next step.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy _____, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
verse: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
note: A widow's single pot of oil filled every borrowed vessel — enough to pay the debt and live on the rest.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And suddenly there was a great _____, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
verse: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
note: At midnight in Philippi, an earthquake opened every prison door and loosed every prisoner's bands.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Esteeming the _____ of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verse: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
note: Moses traded Egypt's treasures for the reproach of God's people — Hebrews calls it the better investment.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art _____, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verse: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
note: In Moses' song, God is 'the Rock that begat thee' — and Israel was 'unmindful' of him. Forgetting is a spiritual act.
